text:
marta: Heads-up — noticed a sudden drop in prefix-cache token-saved for route /search around 20:30 UTC. Hit-rate on redwood/gpt-4o-mini fell from ~82% -> ~43% in ~10m.
jon: link to the panel?
sree: timeline + snapshot please.
marta: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/prefix-cache?from=1715008200&to=1715009999 (slice: /search, model=gpt-4o-mini, customer=acme-corp)
ana: (ana) I pushed a kernel/batching tweak yesterday ~20:10 — bumped max_batch_tokens for small-context paths.
zach: I see a concurrent spike in hotkey entropy for /search -> many near-unique prefixes, which would tank warmup.
perf-bot: profile:run 1715010000 uploaded. Summary: p50 +4ms, kv_evictions +1.2k/s, warmup_hitrate down 39%.
sree: can we get a few sampled keys from the timeframe? need to check normalization variance.
marta: sample keys (sanitized):
`SearchQuery|tenant:acme|uid:1234|prefix:How to bake sourdough`
`SearchQuery|tenant:acme|uid:5678|prefix:how to bake sourdough`
`SearchQuery|tenant:acme|uid:9999|prefix:How to bake sourdough - quick`
zach: that's it — casing + slight punctuation variants exploded the key-space. Key normalizer regression suspected.
ana: PR 0f9b3c removed aggressive lowercasing in key normalizer to preserve tokens for reranking. I can revert on canary.
jon: action items: 1) canary revert normalizer change, 2) add per-tenant token-saved panel + heatmap, 3) run a short (5m) sampling job to collect key entropy buckets, 4) add alert if hit-rate drops >20% for 5m.
sree: I'll add the heatmap panel and alert. Also adding a panel that compares prefetch/warmup success ratio by kernel variant.
marta: starting canary revert now and kicking off sampling job. Uploading eviction log snippet to the thread.
perf-bot: eviction log excerpt (1715009250): `evict_count=1240 reason=kv_size_limit route=/search model=gpt-4o-mini tenant=acme`
zach: also looking at batching heuristic impact — increasing max_batch_tokens can reduce prefix-prefetch throughput for small requests if kernel scheduling moved tasks to slow path. Might be a secondary factor.
ana: rollback deployed to canary cluster (canary-3). Monitoring.
marta: preliminary canary metrics after 3m: hit-rate climbed to 78% on canary vs 45% on prod slice. Token-saved back up.
jon: great. after we stabilize, plan a controlled rollout + add a regression test that asserts no >10% hit-rate degradation when normalizer changes.
sree: noted. I'll add the regression test and a dashboard diff test.
perf-bot: Created issue INF-2345: "prefix-cache-normalizer-regression + per-tenant heatmap" and scheduled sampling job 1715011800.
marta: THANKS everyone — marking as in-progress. Will post postmortem if rollout continues well. :thumbsup:
